incorrect_statement: DroneRF L/H are separate 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz channels
corrected_statement: DroneRF L/H are simultaneous real time-domain amplitude captures of the lower and upper halves of the approximately 80 MHz-wide 2.4 GHz band
compatibility_conclusion: KU Leuven SJRC is still incompatible with the current frozen DroneRF models because it stores 100 MS/s complex IQ while DroneRF stores 40 MS/s real amplitude; a shared derived power or time-frequency representation must be frozen before external evaluation
